nodes.label: StateNFT
nodes.rationale: Minima token metadata (name/url/description) is fixed at tokencreate for every coin of a tokenid, so per-NFT images cannot live there; StateNFT instead puts identity in per-coin state so one tokenid can carry many images.

nodes.label: StateNFT Suite MiniDapp
nodes.rationale: v2 moves create/mint/view/transfer entirely in-app (uid 0x2E22FE01...); minting was pushed into service.js on every new block so it continues with the page closed, self-heals transient errors, and resumes from chain state.

nodes.label: StateNFT Token Script (KISS VM)
nodes.rationale: IF SIGNEDBY(creator) THEN RETURN TRUE ENDIF; RETURN VERIFYOUT(@INPUT GETOUTADDR(@INPUT) @AMOUNT @TOKENID TRUE). Creator bypass is the deliberate mint/stamp escape hatch (standard trust-the-minter assumption); non-creator spends must recreate the coin with identical state so identity travels with the coin. Side effect: coins show sendable:0, so plain wallet send refuses them, protecting users from accidentally invalid transfers.

nodes.label: Per-Coin State Identity
nodes.rationale: Each unit coin carries state port 0 = item index (1..N); image URL = base + index + ext (hosted mode) or a <=8KB base64 thumbnail in state port 1 (embedded mode). State is per-transaction, not per-output, so stamping N identities takes N transactions.

nodes.label: v3.3 Locked Editions
nodes.rationale: Hardened contract: every coin is born with sentinel state 0; the creator bypass works only while unstamped; once stamped, SAMESTATE makes identity content immutable against everyone including the creator. Motivated by discovering that VERIFYOUT's keepstate only checks the store-state flag, letting holders rewrite state under pre-3.3 contracts. Proven on-chain: creator index tamper and image swap rejected; exact-preserve transfers pass. Remedy for old collections is re-minting as a locked edition.

nodes.label: VERIFYOUT keepstate Flag-Only Check
nodes.rationale: VERIFYOUT's keepstate parameter checks only the store-state FLAG, not state content — so pre-3.3 collections (incl. DLNW) prevent identity removal but a holder could rewrite state on coins they hold.

nodes.label: SAMESTATE Immutability
nodes.rationale: SAMESTATE compares state content (not just the flag), closing the rewrite hole VERIFYOUT keepstate leaves open; once a coin is stamped, identity content is immutable against everyone, creator included.

nodes.label: TxPoW 64KB Limit
nodes.rationale: TxPoW has a 64KB cap; ~3 token-carrying outputs + 1 signature per txn is the practical ceiling. This is why embedded images are auto-compressed to <=8KB base64 (transfers carry the image twice: input-coin proof + recreated output state) and why mint.py splits adaptively, keeping coins at the creator address so one signature covers both coin and token script.

nodes.label: mint.py
nodes.rationale: Full pipeline: tokencreate -> split -> stamp, resume-safe; splits adaptively under the TxPoW cap.

nodes.label: transfer.py
nodes.rationale: Identity-preserving transfer CLI — needed because plain wallet send refuses script-token coins (sendable:0), so all moves go through manual transactions that rebuild state.

nodes.label: service.js Background Minter
nodes.rationale: Minting runs in service.js on every new block so it continues with the page closed, self-heals transient errors, and resumes from chain state.

nodes.label: 01-spike.sh (Phase-0 Spike)
nodes.rationale: On-chain proof record: identity-preserving non-creator transfer passes; state-stripping spend posts status:true but is rejected on-chain (never trust txnpost status alone).

nodes.label: rpc.sh
nodes.rationale: curl helper for node RPC on port 4446.

nodes.label: collection.json
nodes.rationale: Collection config: name, size, base URL, creator keys.

nodes.label: EuroBuddha Collection (Live Artifact)
nodes.rationale: 5-item test collection, tokenid 0x12310F9E928A36AFA4C8EE6C4E37D7DDC0353E7727CB4F630254F2E56F934293; sibling throwaway SPIKE-TEST tokenid 0x3DD7DDFC...; v2 E2E proof used a 3-item embedded collection 0x3C451D33... including a two-hop transfer.

nodes.label: Collections View
nodes.rationale: Open any collection by tokenid, or rescan to rediscover StateNFT collections held in the wallet.

nodes.label: Create Collection Wizard
nodes.rationale: Two image-storage modes: on-chain (uploads auto-compressed to embedded thumbnails, kept transferable under the TxPoW cap) vs hosted base+index+ext URLs. Animated GIF icons must be hosted URLs because on-chain embedded icons are always static. Warns that locked editions seal identities by consensus the moment they are stamped — check images before minting.

nodes.label: Detail View (Catalogue Raisonne)
nodes.rationale: Per-collection hero, provenance ledger, holdings bar (mine/held/unseen), filter tabs, gallery, and danger row (bury/remove).

nodes.label: The Loupe Item Inspector
nodes.rationale: Full-screen lot sheet: provenance (token/coin/address), Certificate of Identity (state s0/s1), chronicle timeline, and transfer/copy actions.

nodes.label: Bury Modal (The Graveyard)
nodes.rationale: Irreversible burn flow: sends every held item to the public graveyard address; requires typing the collection name to unlock, and warns extra hard for web-validated (shield-bearing) collections.

nodes.label: Graveyard Address (RETURN FALSE)
nodes.rationale: Public burn address backed by the RETURN FALSE contract — provably unspendable, so burial is forever and no one, including the burier, can retrieve items.

nodes.label: Transfer Modal
nodes.rationale: Send-with-identity flow to a 0x/Mx recipient address.

nodes.label: Mint Progress Rail
nodes.rationale: Phases CREATE -> MOVE(Gather) -> SPLIT -> STAMP -> DONE; runs in the background so the page can be closed.

nodes.label: Recovered Collection Image Resume
nodes.rationale: For mints interrupted before every item was stamped: re-supply images for unstamped items and the background service finishes the mint.

nodes.label: Provenance Ledger
nodes.rationale: Signature check, web proof check, and an expandable KISS VM contract view.

nodes.label: Web Validation (tokenvalidate)
nodes.rationale: Creator hosts a public .txt containing the tokenid; provable via tokenvalidate, surfacing as a verified shield in the provenance ledger and as an extra warning before burial.

nodes.label: Certificate of Identity
nodes.rationale: Identity travels in coin state — the number and the image are re-created verbatim on every transfer, enforced by consensus; the chain is the certificate.
